QuestInfo.name: Eurenth the Sage
QuestInfo.0: Ask #bEurenth#k for information on the city center.
QuestInfo.1: Eurenth isn't giving you the time of day. Use the #bD-03 Transmitter#k to get in touch with the Heliseum Shadowdealers.
QuestInfo.2: #bTonero#k, instead of Romero, answered your summons. Talk to him about Eurenth.

0.msg: I need to know about the city center, old man. So cough up some answers!\r\n

1.msg: You're still here? Do your worst, child. Even if hell freezes over, I have no intention of speaking with the likes of you.\r\n

2.msg: #b(Can you believe this geezer? Talking to him is a waste of time.)#k\r\n

3.msg: #b(It's time to call in some outside help. The Shadowdealers of Heliseum will know what to do.)#k\r\n

0.msg: #b(Use the D-03 Transmitter from the merchant meet-up to get in touch with them.)#k\r\n#r(You will automatically move to the relevant field.)#k\r#r(If you lose the D-03 Transmitter, you can get it again via the quest from the light bulb notifier.)#k\r\n

1.0: 'Tis I, Tonero, Shadowdealer extraordinaire! And what might I do for you today, my illustrious client?\r\n

0.msg: #b(You tell him about your troubles with Eurenth.)#k\r\n

1.msg: Haha! The elderly sage has a most odious personality, to be sure. It will be most difficult to win back his favor.\r\n

2.msg: Fortunately for you, he is plagued by avarice. You might turn this vice to your advantage, no?\r\n

3.msg: I shall tell you what the cantankerous man desires. He will have no choice but to do as you say once you have sated his gluttony!\r\n

0.msg: #b(Use the D-03 Transmitter from the merchant meet-up to get in touch with them.)#k\r\n#r(If you lose the D-03 Transmitter, you can get it again via the quest from the light bulb notifier.)#k\r\n
